verdict.rationale: FreshBooks publishes a well-documented public REST API covering invoices, expenses, payments, journal entries, reports, and webhooks, with OAuth 2.0 authentication, scopes, pagination, error handling, an official Node.js SDK, and a Postman collection — enabling programmatic/agentic control of core accounting workflows. Missing for 10: no llms.txt or machine-readable docs endpoint (probe 404s) and no independent third-party corroboration of API robustness beyond first-party docs.
